decision_rationale: This is an evaluation of an existing generative genome model, not a primary text-bio model. The evidence centers on synthetic bacteriophage genomes and compositional analysis, with no substantive natural-language component or text-bio bridge.
evidence_snippet: "The megaDNA model is the first publicly available generative model for creating synthetic viral genomes"; "compositional metrics for 4969 natural bacteriophage genomes and 1002 de novo synthetic bacteriophage genomes were compared"
